div.div: أُهْبَةٌ Apparatus, equipments, equipage, accoutrements, furniture, gear, tackling, implements, instruments, tools, or the like; (S, A, Msb, K;) as in أُهْبَةُ الحَرْبِ [the apparatus, arms, weapons, equipage, or accoutrements, of war]; (S;) as also هُبَةٌ: (K:) pl. of the former, أُهَبٌ. (S, Msb.) You say, أَخَذَ لِذٰلِكَ الأَمْرِ أُهْبَتهُ [He took his apparatus, &c., for that thing, or affair; also meaning, he made his preparation, or he prepared himself, for it]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
